counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加数字故障风格标题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做视频需要炫酷的故障艺术标题
copy.tagline_en: Add glitch-style titles to your videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need cool glitch art titles for videos

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会输出一个单文件 HTML,即 1920×1080 的故障艺术标题帧:居中粗体大标题带 cyan/magenta 像散伪影和随机切片抖动,并叠扫描线、噪点颗粒、角落 ASCII 噪点与时间码。
howto.when: 当你需要一张 cyberpunk 风格的 hero 单帧或视频转场标题,并给出标题与副标文字时触发。

say.text: 用我的标题「SIGNAL_LOST」做一张故障艺术标题帧
把重故障间隔改成 3 秒,并在故障瞬间加 rgbShift 滤镜
say.note: 按原文参数调整抖动与通道偏移

say.text: 关掉动效,只要静态的 cyan/magenta 像散标题
say.note: 退回静态 chromatic split 版本

howto.what_en: Claude outputs a single-file HTML 1920×1080 glitch title frame: a centered heavy title with cyan/magenta chromatic split and random clip-path slice jitter, plus scanlines, noise grain, corner ASCII chunks and a timecode.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a cyberpunk-style hero frame or video transition title and supply the title and subtitle text.

say_en.text: Make a glitch title frame with my title "SIGNAL_LOST"
Set the heavy glitch to every 3s and add the rgbShift filter
say_en.note: Adjusts jitter timing and channel offset

say_en.text: Turn off motion, keep only the static cyan/magenta split
say_en.note: Falls back to the static chromatic split
